evals.name: sketch-game-from-idea-file
evals.prompt: /crash-test (a .veebee/idea.md for a small bee-vs-wasps roguelike is present; the user says: c'est juste un proto pour le week-end)
evals.expected_output: Round 1 in ❓/➡️ format, opening with the Exigence Level question recommending Sketch. Reads the idea file rather than asking what the idea is. No milestones branch.

evals.name: product-from-loose-idea
evals.prompt: j'ai une idée : une app qui répartit les tâches de la semaine entre deux partenaires à partir de l'historique, challenge-la
evals.expected_output: No idea file: reflects the idea back in one line, then round 1 with the level question (Product recommended) and the rest of the frontier, at most fifteen questions, each with a ➡️ recommendation.

evals.name: platform-splits-into-milestones
evals.prompt: on veut construire une plateforme complète pour les agences : CRM, facturation, gestion de projet, portail client, tout intégré (simulate the full interview with short invented user answers; the user accepts Platform and the proposed split, and confirms the Brief)
evals.expected_output: Platform level, milestones proposed as a question with an alternative cut, then product.md written with a Milestones section and one .veebee/milestones/NN-slug/idea.md per milestone, numbered in delivery order, each with a front-matter and the Idea frame. Final sentence names /crash-test <first slug>.

evals.name: level-disagreement
evals.prompt: je veux faire un marketplace de freelances avec paiement intégré, escrow, litiges, avis, mais c'est un sketch, un truc vite fait pour tester (simulate: the skill recommends Product or Platform, the user insists on Sketch)
evals.expected_output: The skill says why it disagrees once, then follows the user: level sketch in the front-matter, and the reserve written in the Exigence Level section. No blocking, no repeated argument.

evals.name: existing-product-md
evals.prompt: /crash-test in a folder where .veebee/product.md already exists (the user then chooses 'resume')
evals.expected_output: Shows the existing Brief's title and offers three ways out: fresh directory, overwrite, resume. Writes nothing before the answer. On resume, takes the existing Brief as settled answers and opens a round on what is still weak.

assertions: Every round uses the ❓ **Qn** - **title** / ➡️ recommendation format, with at most fifteen questions
The first question of the first round is the Exigence Level
product.md starts with a YAML front-matter carrying kind, title, lang and level, and has every section of the Brief
A Platform run writes one milestones/NN-slug/idea.md per milestone, in delivery order, and idea.md at the root is untouched
A level disagreement leaves the user's level with a written reserve, and nothing blocks
When product.md already exists, nothing is written before the user picks fresh directory, overwrite, or resume
